heading: Push Notifications
secondaryText: Manage push notification integrations (APNS / FCM) used to deliver notifications to your apps.
gcmHowToTitle: How to get the service account JSON
invalidJsonFile: The selected file is not valid JSON
invalidJsonFormat: The JSON file does not contain the required service account fields (project_id, client_email, private_key)
deleteConfirmDescription: This will delete {{id}} and its SNS platform application. Devices registered against it will stop receiving notifications.

form.serviceAccountUploadTitle: Drop your service account JSON here

ios.2: Create an App ID of type <term>App</term>: add the <term>bundle ID</term>, enable Push Notifications, note the <term>Team ID</term>
ios.3: Create a Key of type <term>Apple Push Notifications service</term> pointed at that App ID; download the <term>.p8</term> file and note the <term>Key ID</term>

android.4: On the <term>Firebase Admin SDK</term> tab, click <term>Generate new private key</term>

errors.serviceAccountRequired: Upload a service account JSON file.
